direct_donor_crosscheck.finding: The declared frank_forschung tool policy says explicit-user-request only, while the tool dispatcher routes a model-issued frank_forschung call into _tool_forschung. This confirms that model-facing prose and mechanical admission are distinct architecture layers.

The Realtime session dispatch surface contains distinct branches for status read, memory read/write, delegated task, research, and session termination; therefore one undifferentiated tool-authority bit would erase materially different mutation/effect semantics.

architecture_fusion.core_rule: HUMAN_INTENT != TASK_ADMISSION != CHILD_POLICY_ENVELOPE != MEMORY_ADMISSION != RESEARCH_REQUEST_ADMISSION != EFFECT_DECISION != COMPLETION_DECISION

work_execution.rule: Keep durable workpackage/handoff state, but bind it to observed native agent/task/invocation identity through WorkExecutionBinding before delegated-runtime attribution.

child_policy.rule: Compile an immutable ChildPolicyEnvelope containing effective permission/tool/cwd/settings/policy identity. It records effective child policy but cannot grant itself effect authority.

memory_write.rule: frank_erinnerung_schreiben successor becomes MemoryCandidate -> MemoryAdmission with source utterance, transformation class, epistemic class, generation, privacy/retention and digest before durable commit.

delegated_task.rule: The existing two-step voice confirmation is a HumanIntent predecessor only; every actual mutating child invocation still needs invocation-bound one-shot EffectDecision/CapabilityLease and terminal outcome/completion evidence.

research_submission.rule: frank_forschung/neu_anstossen successor becomes ResearchRequestCandidate -> deterministic HumanIntent/Capability/Privacy/Economic admission before any provider or external submission. Tool-description prose is not authority.

session_control.rule: Voice-session termination remains session control and must not be conflated with canonical/economic/world effect authority.

world_slice_delegation.rule: Any child-visible WorldSlice must carry cycle/workpackage/agent/generation/scope capability provenance; stale, replayed or cross-workpackage capabilities fail closed, and UNKNOWN/NOT_COMPUTED remain epistemically distinct.

preserved_contradictions.a: Current donor source exposes configurable child permission mode and a hard Bash denial in the voice child bridge.
preserved_contradictions.b: Exact installed host/global/managed settings, non-Bash mutating capabilities and lifecycle hook payloads remain unobserved here.

preserved_contradictions.a: Model-facing tool instructions require explicit user request before frank_forschung.
preserved_contradictions.b: Current source evidence does not show an equivalent deterministic fresh-user-intent admission gate at the external submission boundary.

trigger4_feed.delta: No architecture restart and no duplicate child-runtime design. Freeze the typed authority separation above into the Triggerword-4 executor/voice contract and promote only after executable installed-runtime evidence.
p0_gates: Observe installed native child lifecycle and bind workpackage_id -> agent_id/task_id -> exact mutating invocation identity -> terminal state.
Attest effective ChildPolicyEnvelope and enumerate all non-Bash mutating child capability classes.
Prove deterministic denial before any research/provider submission lacking a fresh matching ResearchRequestAdmission.
Prove MemoryAdmission preserves provenance/epistemic/privacy/generation before durable conversational-memory mutation.
DENY must prove non-execution; post-submission uncertainty remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than cancellation success.
p1_gates: Two-child disjoint scratch interleaving with actor/workpackage/generation/invocation lineage.
WorldSlice capability replay/cross-workpackage rejection with UNKNOWN and NOT_COMPUTED preservation.
